name: spotify
description: Icon-only Spotify controls above the prompt (prev/play-pause/next/mute, AppleScript, no login) with a fullscreen sidebar for browsing/playing your playlists and Liked Songs (Spotify Web API, one-time login — just connect, no Spotify Developer app of your own needed).

clientId.title: Spotify Client ID (advanced, optional)
clientId.description: Leave blank to use this mod's own shared Spotify app — just press connect and log in. Only set this if you want to use your own Spotify Developer app instead (developer.spotify.com/dashboard, Redirect URI exactly http://127.0.0.1:8907/callback).
